say:1:1710512001:1.text: The door you seek is still closed.
say:1:1710512001:1.source_cn: 你想去的地方还没有开门。
say:1:1710512001:1.male: The door you seek is still closed.
say:1:1710512001:1.female: The door you seek is still closed.

say:3:1710512002:0.text: I am Harrin, keeper of Vina Cemetery. I've tended these grounds for many years.
say:3:1710512002:0.source_cn: 我是维纳尔墓园的守墓人哈里斯，守护这座墓园已经很多年了。
say:3:1710512002:0.male: I am Harrin, keeper of Vina Cemetery. I've tended these grounds for many years.
say:3:1710512002:0.female: I am Harrin, keeper of Vina Cemetery. I've tended these grounds for many years.

say:5:1710512003:1.text: Everyone who stands before that coffin wants the same thing.
say:5:1710512003:1.source_cn: 因为所有来到这具棺材前的人，目的都是一样的。
say:5:1710512003:1.male: Everyone who stands before that coffin wants the same thing.
say:5:1710512003:1.female: Everyone who stands before that coffin wants the same thing.

say:6:1710512004:1.text: You may enter, but only at night, when darkness falls and the moon rises. Only then will the door open.
say:6:1710512004:1.source_cn: 你可以进去，但要等到晚上，天黑之后，月亮升起时，你想去...
say:6:1710512004:1.male: You may enter, but only at night, when darkness falls and the moon rises. Only then will the door open.
say:6:1710512004:1.female: You may enter, but only at night, when darkness falls and the moon rises. Only then will the door open.

say:7:1710512005:1.text: For now, leave. The cemetery does not welcome the living for long in daylight.
say:7:1710512005:1.source_cn: 现在……你还是先离开吧。墓园白天不欢迎活人久留。
say:7:1710512005:1.male: For now, leave. The cemetery does not welcome the living for long in daylight.
say:7:1710512005:1.female: For now, leave. The cemetery does not welcome the living for long in daylight.

say:8:1710512006:0.text: Use this time to think. Secrets are gained... but secrets are also taken.
say:8:1710512006:0.source_cn: 趁着离开的时间好好想想——获得秘密，也会被索取秘密。
say:8:1710512006:0.male: Use this time to think. Secrets are gained... but secrets are also taken.
say:8:1710512006:0.female: Use this time to think. Secrets are gained... but secrets are also taken.

say:9:1710512007:0.text: Decide what price you're truly willing to pay.
say:9:1710512007:0.source_cn: 你最好想清楚，自己愿意付出什么代价。
say:9:1710512007:0.male: Decide what price you're truly willing to pay.
say:9:1710512007:0.female: Decide what price you're truly willing to pay.

choice:4:0:1.text: How did you know where I wanted to go?
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 你怎么知道我想去哪里？
choice:4:0:1.male: How did you know where I wanted to go?
choice:4:0:1.female: How did you know where I wanted to go?
